cleanup: Pixelized with --scene sorrento, then repainted at native size on candidate 02's layout (door far left, fridge, central window, wall phone, pans, stove, table for two, lemon tree), because the remap turned the wall red-grey, split the floor into blue and grey halves and left heavy speckle. Core plus Sorrento ramp only. Shell: flat terracotta wall with no speckle, a sunlit plaster alcove round the door, dark ceiling boards with splayed beams, a baseboard. Floor: 02's majolica grid rebuilt procedurally in perspective (blue tiles, flower motifs stamped per row so they stay crisp, small blue corner accents), with the grout toned down from bright lemon to dark mustard (J) so it doesn't fight the character. Window: frame, open green louvred shutters and a stone sill redrawn; the view redrawn by hand: a sky in flat bands, the sun low in the west, Ischia as a long low backlit island on the far left with Procida as a small bump, Naples as a line of pale facades with Castel dell'Ovo, Vesuvius broad with the Somma ridge and the cone, lit from the west, a deep blue gulf with short hard-edged glints instead of the reflected sun trail, the tops of Sorrento's lemon groves and a roof below. No ferry in bg: it's anim-ferry. Bowl of lemons and an unlabelled limoncello bottle on the sill. Fridge redrawn smaller (40x63, so it reads next to the character at 0.7 scale) with a rounded crown, shaded left side, sunlit right edge, lever handle, three picture-only postcards, a pale note for the engine's ABOUT label and a bare lower door for the six magnet slots; its shadow falls on the wall to the left. Wall phone redrawn larger (13x14) with the handset on its plate, keypad, and a curly cord hanging in a loop, under a pinned note for the engine's CONTACT label. Majolica plate above the fridge and three copper pans on a rail redrawn. The doorway behind the door is a sunny lane with steps and a lemon-yellow house (the open state without its leaf). Contact shadows under the stove and the table. The stove, table, chairs and door leaf are separate sprites; the lemon tree is fg.
